title: Frozen Meatball Marinara Pasta
description: Frozen meatballs simmered straight from the freezer in marinara while the pasta cooks.

steps.text: Simmer frozen meatballs in marinara until piping hot while the pasta cooks.
Drain pasta, toss with sauce and meatballs, and add Parmesan if wanted.

cookSteps.text:
SIMMER COVERED:
{{q1}} frozen meatballs
{{q2}} marinara sauce

Stir once or twice until meatballs are piping hot.

BOIL:
{{q0}} pasta

Drain when tender.

TOSS pasta with meatballs and sauce. TOP WITH:
{{q3}} Parmesan (optional)

title: Tuna & Cheddar Rice Bowls
description: Hot rice, canned tuna, peas, and cheddar make a simple pantry-and-freezer rescue meal.

steps.text: Heat rice, peas, tuna, and milk together until steaming.
Stir in cheddar and pepper until creamy.

cookSteps.text:
HEAT IN SAUCEPAN:
{{q0}} cooked rice
{{q2}} frozen peas
{{q1}} drained tuna
{{q4}} milk

Stir until steaming hot.

STIR IN:
{{q3}} cheddar
{{q5}} black pepper

Heat until cheese melts.

title: White Bean & Cheese Skillet Tostadas
description: Canned white beans, tortillas, and cheese become crisp skillet tostadas with no thawing required.

ingredients.item: canned white beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Crisp tortillas lightly in oil, spread with beans and cheese, then cover until hot and melted.

cookSteps.text:
MASH:
{{q1}} white beans
{{q3}} taco seasoning

HEAT:
{{q4}} oil

CRISP:
{{q0}} tortillas

Turn once.

TOP TORTILLAS WITH mashed beans and:
{{q2}} cheddar

Cover until hot and melted.

storage: Best fresh; refrigerate bean mixture up to 4 days.

title: Ravioli, Peas & Parmesan Rescue Bowl
description: Frozen ravioli and frozen peas go straight into boiling water, then get butter and Parmesan.

steps.text: Boil frozen ravioli according to the package, adding peas for the last 2 minutes.
Drain and toss with butter, Parmesan, and pepper.

cookSteps.text:
BOIL:
{{q0}} frozen ravioli

Cook according to package directions.

ADD:
{{q1}} frozen peas

Boil with ravioli; drain.

TOSS WITH:
{{q2}} butter
{{q3}} Parmesan
{{q4}} black pepper

title: Deli Turkey & Broccoli Melts
description: Deli turkey, frozen broccoli, and cheddar turn ordinary toast into a hot dinner without thawing meat.

steps.text: Heat broccoli and drain it well.
Top bread with mayo, turkey, broccoli, and cheddar; broil until hot and bubbly.

cookSteps.text:
MICROWAVE UNTIL HOT:
{{q2}} frozen broccoli

Drain very well.

BUILD ON:
{{q0}} bread

ADD:
{{q4}} mayonnaise or butter
{{q1}} deli turkey
{{q2}} broccoli
{{q3}} cheddar
BROIL until cheese bubbles and edges are toasted. Watch closely.

title: Pepper, Egg & Cheese Tortilla Scramble
description: Eggs, frozen peppers and onions, cheese, and tortillas make a dependable breakfast-for-dinner rescue.

steps.text: Cook frozen peppers and onions in butter until hot and most moisture is gone.
Scramble in eggs, add cheddar, and serve with warm tortillas.

cookSteps.text:
HEAT:
{{q4}} butter or oil

COOK:
{{q1}} frozen peppers and onions

Cook until hot and excess moisture cooks away.

ADD AND SCRAMBLE:
{{q0}} eggs

Cook until set.

TOP WITH:
{{q2}} cheddar

SERVE WITH:
{{q3}} warm tortillas

storage: Refrigerate egg mixture up to 3 days.

title: Tortellini & White Bean Tomato Soup
description: Shelf-stable or refrigerated tortellini, canned beans, tomato soup, and frozen spinach make a quick filling soup.

ingredients.item: canned white beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Bring tomato soup and broth to a simmer.
Add tortellini, beans, and spinach and simmer until tortellini is tender and everything is hot.

cookSteps.text:
BRING TO A SIMMER:
{{q2}} tomato soup
{{q3}} water or broth

ADD:
{{q0}} tortellini
{{q1}} white beans
{{q4}} frozen spinach

Simmer until tortellini is tender and soup is piping hot.

title: Black Bean, Corn & Cheese Burritos
description: Canned beans, frozen corn, tortillas, and cheese make a hot filling dinner from freezer and pantry staples.

ingredients.item: canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Heat beans and frozen corn with taco seasoning.
Divide among tortillas, add cheddar, roll, and toast seam-side down in the skillet.

cookSteps.text:
HEAT IN SKILLET:
{{q0}} black beans
{{q1}} frozen corn
{{q2}} taco seasoning

Stir until hot.

DIVIDE FILLING AMONG:
{{q4}} tortillas

ADD:
{{q3}} cheddar

Roll into burritos.
TOAST burritos seam-side down in the skillet, turning once, until lightly crisp.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days; reheat until hot.
